# P102 — project-type detection and the ship-sop auto gate

Source: `scripts/hooks/sop-lib.sh` (`sop_project_type`, `sop_is_code_repo`, `sop_shipsop_gate`, `sop_code_lines`, `sop_shipsop_covered`, `sop_range_base`); config keys read from `ship-sop.config.json`; `scripts/hooks/sop-stop-drift.sh` for the Stop hook's own guard order (P103).

No HTTP API exists in this repository (bash hooks and Markdown slash commands only), so the API-catalog section is skipped for this ship.

## Decision flowchart

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph SG1["sop_project_type(root) — code vs non-code"]
        PT_start(["sop_project_type(root)"]) --> PT_root{"root is a directory?"}
        PT_root -- "no" --> PT_NONCODE["Result: non-code"]
        PT_root -- "yes" --> PT_claude{"CLAUDE.md exists at root?"}

        PT_claude -- "no" --> PT_manifest
        PT_claude -- "yes" --> PT_decl{"Declaration line matches<br/>'[*_]Project type[*_]: code|non-code'<br/>(bold optional, case-insensitive)?"}

        PT_decl -- "yes — wins outright" --> PT_DECLARED["Result: the declared value<br/>(code or non-code)"]
        PT_decl -- "no" --> PT_heading{"Heuristic (a): CLAUDE.md has a<br/>## Auth / ## Database / ## Design System<br/>heading?"}

        PT_heading -- "yes" --> PT_CODE["Result: code"]
        PT_heading -- "no" --> PT_template{"Heuristic (b): CLAUDE.md references<br/>claude-md-template-code.md?"}

        PT_template -- "yes" --> PT_CODE
        PT_template -- "no" --> PT_testcmd{"Heuristic (c): the ## Key Commands<br/>section runs a real test-suite command<br/>(npm/pnpm/yarn/bun test, pytest, jest,<br/>vitest, cargo test, go test, make test —<br/>the word 'test' in prose does not count)?"}

        PT_testcmd -- "yes" --> PT_CODE
        PT_testcmd -- "no" --> PT_manifest{"Heuristic (d): root carries<br/>package.json, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml,<br/>go.mod, or Gemfile?"}

        PT_manifest -- "yes" --> PT_CODE
        PT_manifest -- "no" --> PT_NONCODE
    end

    subgraph SG2["sop_shipsop_gate(root) — auto-mode ship gate"]
        SG_start(["sop_shipsop_gate(root)"]) --> SG_cfg{"ship-sop.config.json<br/>exists at root?"}
        SG_cfg -- "no" --> SG_SILENT["silent — prints '' (exit 0)"]
        SG_cfg -- "yes" --> SG_jq{"jq available on PATH?"}

        SG_jq -- "no" --> SG_SILENT
        SG_jq -- "yes" --> SG_mode{"trigger.mode == 'auto'?"}

        SG_mode -- "no (manual / absent)" --> SG_SILENT
        SG_mode -- "yes" --> SG_isCode{"sop_is_code_repo(root)?"}

        SG_isCode -- "non-code" --> SG_SILENT
        SG_isCode -- "code" --> SG_branch{"current branch matches any<br/>trigger.throttle.skip_branch_patterns<br/>(e.g. ^wip/, ^spike/, ^exp/)?"}

        SG_branch -- "yes" --> SG_SILENT
        SG_branch -- "no" --> SG_diverged{"sop_range_base(root) non-empty?<br/>(HEAD has diverged from the<br/>default branch; empty if not<br/>or no origin)"}

        SG_diverged -- "no" --> SG_SILENT
        SG_diverged -- "yes" --> SG_lines{"code lines base..HEAD, docs<br/>extensions (.md/.markdown/.txt/.rst)<br/>always excluded, >= trigger.throttle<br/>.min_diff_lines (default 10)?"}

        SG_lines -- "no" --> SG_SILENT
        SG_lines -- "yes" --> SG_covered{"sop_shipsop_covered(root, HEAD)?<br/>some docs/reviews/*-ship-auto.md has<br/>'Covers: &lt;sha&gt;' where sha is an<br/>ancestor of HEAD with 0 code lines<br/>(docs excluded) between sha and HEAD?"}

        SG_covered -- "yes — covered" --> SG_SILENT
        SG_covered -- "no" --> SG_EMIT["Emit gate demand:<br/>line count, branch, default branch,<br/>base..head shas, report path<br/>docs/reviews/&lt;ts&gt;-ship-auto.md,<br/>enabled-agent list with block_on,<br/>auto-mode rules for CRITICAL/HIGH/<br/>MEDIUM/LOW handling"]
    end

    SG_isCode -.->|"delegates to"| PT_start
```

## Stop hook guard order (P103)

`sop-stop-drift.sh` runs every guard below in order on every `Stop` event; the first one that doesn't hold exits 0 with no output. Added by P103: the `sop_is_code_repo` check, placed immediately after the SOP-repo guard — so a non-code SOP repo never reaches the drift/dirty/gate checks or the throttle marker at all.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph SG3["sop-stop-drift.sh — Stop hook guard order"]
        ST_start(["Stop event fires"]) --> ST_jq{"jq on PATH?<br/>(sop_have_jq)"}
        ST_jq -- "no" --> ST_EXIT0["exit 0 (silent)"]
        ST_jq -- "yes" --> ST_read["Read hook input JSON from stdin<br/>(sop_read_input)"]
        ST_read --> ST_active{"input .stop_hook_active == true?"}
        ST_active -- "yes" --> ST_EXIT0
        ST_active -- "no" --> ST_root["CWD = input .cwd, else $PWD<br/>ROOT = sop_repo_root(CWD)"]
        ST_root --> ST_sop{"sop_is_sop_repo(ROOT)?<br/>(Backlog.md + docs/sop/claude-agent-sop.md)"}
        ST_sop -- "no" --> ST_EXIT0
        ST_sop -- "yes" --> ST_code{"sop_is_code_repo(ROOT)?<br/>[P103 — new guard, delegates to<br/>sop_project_type, see SG1 above]"}
        ST_code -- "non-code" --> ST_EXIT0
        ST_code -- "code" --> ST_head{"HEAD resolvable?<br/>(git rev-parse HEAD)"}
        ST_head -- "no" --> ST_EXIT0
        ST_head -- "yes" --> ST_facts["Compute facts:<br/>DRIFT = sop_drift_commits(ROOT)<br/>DIRTY = sop_tracker_dirty(ROOT)<br/>GATE = sop_shipsop_gate(ROOT)"]
        ST_facts --> ST_any{"DRIFT or DIRTY or GATE<br/>non-empty (any fact holds)?"}
        ST_any -- "no" --> ST_EXIT0
        ST_any -- "yes" --> ST_throttle{"Throttle: marker at<br/>state-dir/repos/&lt;key&gt;/stop.marker<br/>== sig(HEAD, sha256(DIRTY), gate-flag)?"}
        ST_throttle -- "yes — unchanged since last notice" --> ST_EXIT0
        ST_throttle -- "no — write new marker" --> ST_EMIT["Compose reason (drift commits,<br/>dirty trackers, gate demand) to<br/>stderr; exit 2 — Claude Code feeds<br/>stderr back to the model, turn continues"]
    end

    ST_code -.->|"delegates to"| PT_start
```

## ARCHITECTURE delta

- `sop-stop-drift.sh` and `sop-push-gate.sh` call `sop_shipsop_gate` directly (which calls `sop_is_code_repo` → `sop_project_type`); `sop-session-context.sh` calls both `sop_project_type` and `sop_shipsop_gate` directly to populate the context block.
- `sop-project-type.sh` is the executable wrapper around `sop_project_type`, installed at `~/.claude/scripts/hooks/agent-sop/`; `/update-sop` and `/finish` shell out to it when no context block is already present in the session.
- `/restart-sop` does not call the rule itself — it reads the context block `sop-session-context.sh` already wrote (Steps 0-4), or runs its own checklist when that block is absent.
- ship-sop's `/ship` reads the same rule per `docs/sop/claude-agent-sop.md` and `docs/sop/compliance-checklist.md`, though `/ship`'s own source lives outside this diff.
- Why: P102 — the operator's rule (2026-09-04) is that ship-sop fires for coding and for nothing else, so every consumer above must resolve code/non-code identically or a gate nags a prose repo, or unreviewed code goes through unchecked.
- P103: `sop-stop-drift.sh` gained `sop_is_code_repo "$ROOT" || exit 0` directly after the SOP-repo guard, so the whole Stop hook — drift commits, dirty trackers, and the ship-sop gate check — is silent on a non-code project, not just the gate clause within it (which was already code-only per P102's `sop_shipsop_gate`).
- `sop-session-context.sh`'s closing line now branches on `sop_project_type`: code projects still read "Session-end is enforced by the Stop hook"; non-code projects read "the Stop hook enforces nothing here" while the DRIFT/DIRTY facts above it still print.
- Why: operator reply to the P102 report, 2026-09-04 — the drift half of the Stop hook is code-only too; a non-code SOP repo's deliberate session close stays `/update-sop`.
